title: C$^2$U in RAG: Compositional Concept Unlearning in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.29223v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation can expose unwanted concepts through retrieved evidence even when the generator is moderated. We study query-side concept suppression with a fixed encoder and document index. Compositional Concept Unlearning (C$^2$U) routes a profile-derived direction through an augmented atom bank, adding only a bounded edited-minus-original delta to the raw query. Across five datasets, four encoders, and three seeds, the validation-selected configuration reduces pooled binary target Hit@5 by 4.25 percentage points with non-positive control degradation and target-exposure changes. Under the evaluated query transforms, it suppresses target density without increasing budgeted control-query exposure. Separately, ArXiv four-concept composition improves over an averaged-direction comparator after independent validation gates and first-use test evaluation.

translated_title: C²U在检索增强生成中的应用：检索增强生成中的组合式概念遗忘
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）即使在对生成器进行审核控制的情况下，仍可能通过检索到的证据暴露不想要的概念。我们研究了在固定编码器和文档索引条件下的查询侧概念抑制问题。组合式概念遗忘（C²U）方法将通过配置文件导出的方向路由到增强的原子库中，仅在原始查询上添加一个有界的“编辑后减去原始”增量。在五个数据集、四个编码器和三个随机种子的实验中，经验证选择的最优配置将汇总的二分类目标Hit@5降低了4.25个百分点，同时控制组退化非正（即无负面影响），目标暴露变化也非正。在所评估的查询变换下，该方法在抑制目标概念密度的同时，不会增加预算内的控制查询暴露。此外，在经过独立验证门控和首次使用测试评估后，ArXiv四概念组合任务上的表现优于基于平均方向的对比方法。
tldr: 本文提出组合式概念遗忘方法C²U，通过将有界查询增量与增强原子库路由相结合，在检索增强生成中有效抑制目标概念暴露，使目标Hit@5降低4.25个百分点且不增加控制查询暴露。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Compositional Concept Unlearning (C²U), which suppresses unwanted concept exposure in retrieval-augmented generation by routing profile-derived directions through an augmented atom bank with bounded query deltas, reducing pooled target Hit@5 by 4.25 percentage points without increasing control-query exposure.
